$comment: Conflicts confirmed by hand. Detection can only say that coverage is abnormal; a human decides whether that is a conflict. Each entry here arrives as a pull request generated from a candidate, and merging it is what puts the conflict on the map.
$shapeNote: Entries are self-contained on purpose. A candidate can expire out of data/candidates.json long before anyone reviews it, so the sources that justified it are copied in rather than referenced.
